subject.title: Docs option: quick-try link for the autoreview Skill

question: Should official ClawHub docs include a ClawMama Telegram/WhatsApp quick-try link for the autoreview skill alongside the registry install flow?
rationale: The implementation would be a small docs change, but the policy choice is whether official ClawHub documentation should endorse an external hosted trial surface with campaign tracking.

options.title: Approve a labeled optional link
options.body: Add the link only with wording that makes ClawMama external, optional, and not a replacement for ClawHub install/inspect commands.

options.title: Keep docs ClawHub-native
options.body: Leave the docs focused on ClawHub and OpenClaw commands until a maintainer-approved trial surface exists.

options.title: Wait for a native try flow
options.body: Track the idea for a ClawHub-owned quick-try experience instead of linking to a third-party flow now.

recommendation.title: Approve a labeled optional link
recommendation.body: Add the link only with wording that makes ClawMama external, optional, and not a replacement for ClawHub install/inspect commands.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest recent owner signal for the docs and bundled skill surface in the available history.
